thread:
aaron: quick PSA — the fern in breakout has been promoted to "Sir Photosynth" effective immediately. It accepted a tiny paper crown this morning. :crown:
tia: promotions that actually improve morale are my favorite kind of process change. long live Sir Photosynth. :herb:
rachel: who crowned it?? i missed the ceremony. was there a speech?
aaron: short speech. i read an excerpt from our onboarding doc and bowed. opera music in my head.
tia: there is a commemorative sticky behind the plant. it says: 'may your leaves always be misted'. very stirring.
ops-bot: FYI — plants are allowed in common areas per office policy. please water responsibly.
rachel: suggestion: we should give Sir Photosynth an office nickname based on its coping mechanisms. "fernzilla"? "leafy mcleafface"?
aaron: fernzilla is terrifying but has bravado. i vote "Photosynth Prime".
tia: i made a tiny nameplate from a business card and a popsicle stick. will deliver at 3pm. craft economy booming.
coffee-bot: :coffee: in celebration, first pour of the 3pm coffee round is dedicated to Sir Photosynth. claim your beverage with the password 'chlorophyll'.
rachel: i'll add Sir Photosynth to the rotating plant-sitter calendar. responsibilities: gentle misting, whispered compliments, occasional Spotify lute playlist.
aaron: i nominate tia for plant-sitter 1 since she brought the crown. also tia is very good at vibes.
tia: honored. i'll also enforce a solemn leaf-count every Friday. it's a small duty, but it keeps me humble.
ops-bot: Reminder: please don't place candles, open flames, or glitter near plants. glitter gets everywhere.
rachel: noted. no glitter coronations. also we should make a tiny lore doc in the Kitchen Lore binder. who has a laminator?
aaron: i have laminate sheets. i'll bring them tomorrow. maybe we can laminate the original coronation sticky for preservation.
tia: plot twist — Sir Photosynth becomes mascot for our snack drawer etiquette. if snacks are left on the counter, Sir Photosynth will wither dramatically (metaphorically). :wink:
coffee-bot: :bell: Mascot registration successful. Sir Photosynth assigned emoji :herb:.
rachel: this has been an excellent use of Slack. next step: celebratory sticker for laptops. i'll draft designs.
aaron: i'm starting a tiny fanclub channel but will keep it low-traffic. tag: #sir-photosynth-oracle. membership requirement: at least one tasteful plant pun.
tia: i'll start: "fern-tastic day to you all".
rachel: shameless follow-up — if anyone finds a tiny paper crown on their desk, it's not trash. it's royal regalia. return to Sir Photosynth immediately.
aaron: long live Sir Photosynth. may its leaves be un-crumbled.
